contract.description: Generate a classic HMI TEXT LIST or GRAPHIC LIST (WinCC Basic/Comfort panels, TIA V16-V21) as SimaticML XML from a structured plan. Classic HMI Openness has NO Create for lists (TextListComposition/GraphicListComposition only declare Import), so whole-list XML import is the only authoring path: generate, then import with tia_openness_import_hmi_xml (kind=text-list / graphic-list, or omit kind and let the sniffer read the root element). EVERY SHAPE HERE IS MEASURED on a real V18 round trip (2026-09-16) - in particular an entry's identity is the From/To RANGE, not a Value attribute: TIA answers "The 'Value' attribute at the 'Siemens.Engineering.Hmi.TextGraphicList.TextListEntry' object ... is not supported", while From/To (the model's IHmiListEntry.From/.To) imports and re-exports identically. A single value is the degenerate range from == to. entry_type is SingleValue (default) or Range (both verified, Range verified with from=5/to=9); default_entry is a bool and at most one entry may set it; a text list entry's text goes to a MultilingualText composition named Text. GRAPHIC LIST ENTRIES MUST BE SINGLE VALUES: TIA requires From == To for a graphic list of the type "Single value" and answers a non-degenerate range with a NonRecoverableException that CLOSES the TIA Portal (measured on V18 2026-09-16) - the generator therefore refuses from != to for kind=graphic-list before writing anything. Text lists are the kind whose entries accept ranges. list_range defaults to Decimal - the only value verified end-to-end; anything else is emitted as given with a warning (not refused, since the manual lists other range types we have not measured). A graphic-list entry's picture reference has NO verified shape yet: pass picture and it is reported as a warning, not written. The document is generated offline (no TIA attach) and is NOT machine proof - import it, then re-export to confirm.

output_path.description: Optional file path; omitted returns the XML inline.

culture.description: Project language for the entry texts, e.g. zh-CN (default) or en-US. Must exist in the target project or TIA rejects the import.

entries.description: The list entries. Every entry must cover a distinct range; a text list entry should carry text.

default_entry.description: Mark this entry as the list's default entry (default false). At most one entry may set it.

entry_type.description: SingleValue (default) or Range. Both verified on a real import; any other value is refused rather than guessed.

from.description: Range start. Omit both from/to and the entry is refused (the range IS the identity). For kind=graphic-list this must equal `to` - TIA rejects a graphic-list range with a NonRecoverableException that closes the Portal.

picture.description: Graphic list only, and NOT written: a graphic-list entry's picture reference has no verified shape yet - it is reported as a warning so the picture can be assigned in TIA.

text.description: Entry text (MultilingualText, in plan.culture). A text entry without text imports but shows nothing - reported as a warning.

to.description: Range end; defaults to from (single value). Must equal `from` for a graphic list entry.

kind.description: text-list (default) or graphic-list. Accepts textlist/graphiclist spellings.

list_range.description: Range type of the list. Default Decimal (the only value verified end-to-end). Any other value is written as given with a warning.

mode.description: Graphic list only: Simple (default) or Enhanced. Ignored with a warning for a text list.

name.description: List name (the object name TIA creates).

schema_version.description: TIA version for the document header, e.g. V18. Defaults to the project's openness_version, else V17.

contract.name: tia_hmi_generate_list_xml
